page.title: Material 3 theme
page.description: Uses layered background tones instead of borders and shadows, with subtle translucent overlays for hover and press feedback, generating matched light and dark palettes together.
page.enabledDescription: Applies Material 3 colors to backgrounds, text, controls, and interactive states. Turn off to restore your previous theme.

page.note: Changes apply immediately and are saved locally across reloads without restarting the app.
